note: Weights below are community-derived estimates from reverse-engineering published architecture docs and public engagement studies. X does not publish exact numeric weights. Treat all numeric values as hypotheses, not facts.

positive.description: User clicks a link in the post
User follows the author after seeing post

linkRisk.hypothesis: Posts with external links are distributed less aggressively in For You feed. X prefers native content.
linkRisk.suggestedWorkaround: Put link in first reply, or use 'link in bio' approach.

replyBoost.hypothesis: Questions and direct conversation invitations meaningfully raise P(reply), which is a high-weight positive signal.

mediaBoost.hypothesis: Native video (MP4) and images increase P(video_view) and P(photo_expand) signals, boosting overall score.

engagementBaitPenalty.hypothesis: Explicit engagement-bait phrases ('like if', 'rt if', 'drop a like') trigger P(not_interested) and are likely filtered pre-rank.

hardSellPenalty.hypothesis: 'Buy now', 'limited time', 'act now' patterns correlate with high P(not_interested) and P(mute_author).

dwellLengthCorrelation.hypothesis: Longer, substantive posts may increase dwell time, but very long posts risk lower completion rate. Optimal range unclear.

authorDiversityAttenuation.hypothesis: Phoenix Scorer penalizes repeated same-author exposure in a single feed session. Cadence matters more than volume.

topicConsistency.hypothesis: Consistent topical posting helps the candidate retrieval tower (Two-Tower Model) surface posts to relevant audiences.
